# -- eotg_test_harness.txt ------------------------------------------------------
# GENERATED by docs/tools/gen_test_harness.py: never hand-edit; change the generator and re-run.
# In-game test harness: the delayed assertions (docs/qa/TEST_HARNESS.md).
# Every event here is HIDDEN and fired ONLY by an eotg_decision_test_*
# decision (common/decisions/eotg_test_harness_decisions.txt in this sub-mod), which are
# debug_only (invariant 4: always fired by something; no on_action hook).
# Root = the decision taker. Scopes saved by the decision (eotg_test_county,
# eotg_test_target, eotg_test_subject, actor, recipient) carry into the delayed
# event, as the mod's own chains rely on (e.g. eotg_aug_heir.006 reads
# scope:eotg_heir days later).
# Assertions read the systems' own scripted triggers and values only.
# UNVERIFIED-VANILLA: debug_log writes its literal string to logs/debug.log (the
#   effect is used in v2 script, eotg_race_effects.txt, with data functions;
#   the strings here are plain text on purpose).
# Tiger and PX checked locally (2026-11-03); not yet run in game.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace = eotg_test

eotg_test.101 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_is_aug_tier1 = yes
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.1 PASS: Augmented (tier 1)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.1 FAIL: not tier 1 after eotg_aug_initiate_effect"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                prowess >= { value = var:eotg_test_prowess_base add = 2 }
                prowess <= { value = var:eotg_test_prowess_base add = 2 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.2 PASS: prowess +2 at Augmented"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY1.2 FAIL: prowess is not base +2 at Augmented"
        }
        eotg_aug_set_integration_effect = { XP = 50 }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.102  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.131 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_trait = eotg_neurofractured
                NOT = { has_trait = eotg_cybernetics }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4.1 PASS: the pulse cascaded: Neurofractured, cybernetics trait gone"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4.1 FAIL: no cascade from the yearly pulse at risk 80 (threshold check or eotg_trigger_neurofracture)"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:eotg_fracture_risk ?= 0
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4.2 PASS: the cascade reset the fracture risk to 0"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4.2 FAIL: the fracture risk was not reset after the cascade"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4 LOOK: the cascade event eotg_fracture.0001 arrives today or tomorrow"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST CY4 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.201 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = {
                    eotg_frontier_is_frontier = yes
                    var:eotg_frontier_type ?= flag:military
                }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.1 PASS: the capital is a military Frontier"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.1 FAIL: the capital is not a Frontier of that type (was it Abandoned and not resettlable?)"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_has_valid_founder = yes }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.2 PASS: you are its valid founder"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a.2 FAIL: no valid founder recorded"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a LOOK: the Shoal shows Frontier: Outpost; (Debug) Frontier Readout gives progress and strain"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR1a DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.211 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = {
                    NOT = { has_variable = eotg_frontier_state }
                }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2.1 PASS: the Frontier completed and cleared (normal play takes over)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2.1 FAIL: still a Frontier a week later: the completion event was left unanswered, or the development or control floor was not met; see the Readout"
        }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_test_type ?= flag:military } }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 LOOK: E-12 / SI V8: hover the new Bastion barony, note who holds it and whether a stray character was created"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_test_type ?= flag:religious } }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 LOOK: FX-2: note the new Sanctum holder gender (expected male under a male-only clergy); G-2: note their government and the vassal contract"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 LOOK: E-4: which holding appeared and who holds it (never the founder unless they rule); G-2: the Local Ruler government and contract"
        }
        scope:eotg_test_county = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = eotg_test_type }
                remove_variable = eotg_test_type
            }
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR2 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.221 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_frontier_progress <= 100 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.1 PASS: progress 98 + 4 is clamped at 100"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.1 FAIL: progress went above 100"
        }
        scope:eotg_test_county = {
            set_variable = { name = eotg_frontier_strain  value = 8 }
            eotg_frontier_add_strain_effect = { CAUSE = hardship }
        }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.222  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.222 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { var:eotg_frontier_strain <= 8 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.2 PASS: strain 8 + 1 is clamped at 8"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR3.2 FAIL: strain went above 8"
        }
        scope:eotg_test_county = {
            set_variable = { name = eotg_frontier_strain  value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = eotg_frontier_progress  value = 1 }
            eotg_frontier_add_progress_effect = { AMOUNT = -3 }
        }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.223  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.223 = {
    type = character_event

eotg_test.251 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_is_unknown = yes }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5.1 PASS: the capital is Unknown"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5.1 FAIL: the exploration variable was not set"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5 LOOK: the Unexplored Shoal tooltip itself is session-plan check 0-1 (c_tortoli on playset A)"
        scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_clear_exploration_effect = yes }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_county = { eotg_frontier_is_unknown = no }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5.2 PASS: exploration cleared again: the capital is Known (it stays Unsettled)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5.2 FAIL: eotg_frontier_clear_exploration_effect left the capital Unknown"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST FR5 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.301 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eotg_test_target = { has_subject_contract_group = eotg_cartel_tributary }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.1 PASS: the neighbour is a payer in eotg_cartel_tributary"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.1 FAIL: the neighbour is not in the Cartel contract group"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_cartel_payer_count_value >= 1
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.2 PASS: the payer count sees the new payer"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.2 FAIL: eotg_cartel_payer_count_value is 0"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_cartel_schedule_scale_value >= { value = var:eotg_test_scale_before add = 4 }
                eotg_cartel_schedule_scale_value <= { value = var:eotg_test_scale_before add = 4 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.3 PASS: the dread baseline mirror rose by exactly 4 for the new payer"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1.3 FAIL: eotg_cartel_schedule_scale did not rise by exactly 4"
        }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_scale_before
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 LOOK: the character window shows +4 Dread baseline per payer; the Payment Schedule story counter matches your dread"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV1 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.311 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_cartel_payer_count_value < var:eotg_test_payers_before
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.1 PASS: one payer walked off"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.1 FAIL: the payer count did not fall"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_cartel_payer_count_value >= { value = var:eotg_test_payers_before add = -1 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.2 PASS: no more than one payer left"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2.2 FAIL: more than one payer left in a single walk-off"
        }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_payers_before
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2 LOOK: the A Payer Walks toast named the payer; the baseline modifier dropped by 4"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GV2 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.321 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_pmc_standing_value >= { value = var:eotg_test_before add = var:eotg_test_delta }
                eotg_pmc_standing_value <= { value = var:eotg_test_before add = var:eotg_test_delta }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.1 PASS: standing moved by exactly the delta"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.1 FAIL: standing did not move by exactly the delta through the writer"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_owned_story = {
                    story_type = eotg_story_pmc_standing
                    var:eotg_pmc_standing_shown >= root.var:eotg_pmc_standing
                    var:eotg_pmc_standing_shown <= root.var:eotg_pmc_standing
                }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.2 PASS: the story counter mirrors the new value (sync effect ran)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.2 FAIL: the eotg_story_pmc_standing counter does not match the value after a write"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_character_modifier = eotg_pmc_standing_modifier
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.3 PASS: the scaled modifier is present after the write (re-applied)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.3 FAIL: eotg_pmc_standing_modifier is missing after a write"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.4 LOOK: hover eotg_pmc_standing_modifier: its numbers must match the new value, not the old one (a scaled modifier is computed when added; the writer re-applies it)"
        eotg_pmc_change_standing_effect = { AMOUNT = 120 }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.322  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.322 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_pmc_standing_value >= 100
                eotg_pmc_standing_value <= 100
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.5 PASS: standing +120 clamps at 100"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.5 FAIL: standing is not 100 after +120"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_owned_story = {
                    story_type = eotg_story_pmc_standing
                    var:eotg_pmc_standing_shown >= root.var:eotg_pmc_standing
                    var:eotg_pmc_standing_shown <= root.var:eotg_pmc_standing
                }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.6 PASS: the story counter follows the clamp"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.6 FAIL: the story counter does not show the clamped value"
        }
        save_scope_value_as = { name = eotg_test_back  value = { value = var:eotg_test_before subtract = 100 } }
        eotg_pmc_change_standing_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:eotg_test_back }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_pmc_standing_value >= var:eotg_test_before
                eotg_pmc_standing_value <= var:eotg_test_before
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.7 PASS: standing restored to the baseline"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1.7 FAIL: standing not restored to the baseline"
        }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_before
        remove_variable = eotg_test_delta
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST GP1 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.501 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_whispers }
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_pressure }
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_saturation }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.1 PASS: exposure 24: no band"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.1 FAIL: a band modifier is present at exposure 24"
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eotg_test_delta
            value = {
                value = 25
                subtract = var:eotg_void_exposure
            }
        }
        eotg_void_change_exposure_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:eotg_test_delta }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.502  days = 1 }
    }
}

    immediate = {

                has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_pressure
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_saturation }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.3 PASS: exposure 50: Void Pressure only (Whispers removed)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.3 FAIL: exposure 50 is not Pressure alone"
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eotg_test_delta
            value = {
                value = 75
                subtract = var:eotg_void_exposure
            }
        }

        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.504  days = 1 }
    }

eotg_test.504 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_whispers }
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_pressure }
                has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_saturation
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.4 PASS: exposure 75: Void Saturation only"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.4 FAIL: exposure 75 is not Saturation alone"
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eotg_test_delta
            value = {
                value = var:eotg_test_before
                subtract = var:eotg_void_exposure
            }
        }
        eotg_void_change_exposure_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:eotg_test_delta }
        if = {
            limit = { var:eotg_void_exposure < 25 }
            if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_whispers }
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_pressure }
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_saturation }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.5 PASS: restored below 25: no band"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.5 FAIL: a band survived the restore"
        }
        }
        else = {
            if = {
            limit = {
                OR = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_whispers has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_pressure has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_saturation }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.5 PASS: restored: a band matches the restored exposure"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1.5 FAIL: no band after restoring an exposure of 25 or more"
        }
        }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_before
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1 LOOK: the band modifier tooltip text (Whispers, Pressure, Saturation)"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD1 DONE (exposure restored; VD1 may have advanced Void events: the on_action reads exposure yearly)"
    }
}

    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {

        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD2.1 FAIL: no cooldown flag after the pulse fired: the on_action is not the cooldown authority, or the Hollowing branch did not fire"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:eotg_void_exposure >= 100
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD2.2 PASS: exposure is at the cap (Touched accrual cannot lower it)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD2.2 FAIL: exposure fell below 100 after the pulse"
        }
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD2 LOOK: The Hollowing (eotg_void.0030) arrives within 10 days; answer it, then take VD3"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD2 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.521 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_hollow_far
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_hollow_quiet }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.3 PASS: depth 50: Far Off only"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.3 FAIL: depth 50 is not Far Off alone"
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eotg_test_delta
            value = {
                value = 85
                subtract = var:eotg_void_hollowing_depth
            }
        }
        eotg_void_change_hollowing_depth_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:eotg_test_delta }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.522  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.522 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_hollow_far }
                has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_hollow_quiet
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.4 PASS: depth 85: Gone Quiet only (Far Off removed)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.4 FAIL: depth 85 is not Gone Quiet alone"
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eotg_test_delta
            value = {
                value = 10
                subtract = var:eotg_void_hollowing_depth
            }
        }
        eotg_void_change_hollowing_depth_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:eotg_test_delta }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.523  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.523 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_hollow_far }
                NOT = { has_character_modifier = eotg_mod_void_hollow_quiet }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.5 PASS: depth 10: no depth band"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.5 FAIL: a depth band survived at depth 10"
        }
        # The real pulse: depth drift +4. The Hollowing set a 5-year cooldown, so no
        # stage-D event should roll; if the cooldown has lapsed, 0031 or 0032 may follow.
        trigger_event = { on_action = eotg_on_yearly_void_check }
        trigger_event = { id = eotg_test.524  days = 1 }
    }
}

eotg_test.524 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:eotg_void_hollowing_depth >= 14
                var:eotg_void_hollowing_depth <= 14
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.6 PASS: the yearly pulse drifted depth by exactly +4"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3.6 FAIL: depth did not drift by exactly +4 in one pulse"
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eotg_test_delta
            value = {
                value = var:eotg_test_before
                subtract = var:eotg_void_hollowing_depth
            }
        }
        eotg_void_change_hollowing_depth_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:eotg_test_delta }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_before
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3 LOOK: the Far Off and Gone Quiet tooltips"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD3 DONE (depth restored)"
    }
}

eotg_test.531 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                any_courtier = { has_character_flag = eotg_flag_void_voidwalker }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.1 PASS: the Voidwalker is a flagged courtier (the flag is no longer on the ruler)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.1 FAIL: no courtier carries eotg_flag_void_voidwalker"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_void_yearly_accrual_value >= { value = var:eotg_test_before add = -6 }
                eotg_void_yearly_accrual_value <= { value = var:eotg_test_before add = -6 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.2 PASS: the yearly accrual fell by exactly 6"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.2 FAIL: the accrual did not fall by 6 with a Voidwalker at court"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_trait = eotg_void_hollowed
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.3 SKIP: the Hollowed cannot take the Voidwalker Ward"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_character_flag = eotg_flag_void_ward_cooldown
                    gold < 100
                }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.3 SKIP: the ward cooldown is running or you have under 100 gold; the decision should still be listed, greyed out (LOOK)"
        }
        else = {
            if = {
            limit = {
                can_execute_decision = eotg_decision_void_voidwalker_ward
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.3 PASS: the Voidwalker Ward decision can be taken"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4.3 FAIL: the Voidwalker Ward decision cannot be taken with a Voidwalker at court"
        }
        }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_before
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4 LOOK: the Decisions tab lists Ask the Voidwalker for the Old Ward"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD4 DONE"
    }
}

eotg_test.541 = {
    type = character_event
    hidden = yes

    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                { value = diplomacy add = martial add = stewardship add = intrigue add = learning add = prowess } >= { value = var:eotg_test_before add = 4 }
                { value = diplomacy add = martial add = stewardship add = intrigue add = learning add = prowess } <= { value = var:eotg_test_before add = 4 }
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD5.1 PASS: two Insights gave +2 skill each (+4 total)"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD5.1 FAIL: the skill total did not rise by exactly 4"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eotg_void_has_any_insight = yes
            }
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD5.2 PASS: an Insight modifier is held"
        }
        else = {
            debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD5.2 FAIL: no Insight modifier after the effect"
        }
        remove_variable = eotg_test_before
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD5.3 LOOK: the character window lists ONE Insight modifier, not two copies"
        debug_log = "EOTG_TEST VD5 DONE"
    }
}
